title: Chapter 122: Wake Him Up!
html:
Men Nan looked terrifying, as though possessed. After nearly ten minutes, he again planted his arms beneath him. Several failed attempts later, he finally forced himself upright.

He sat on the bed with his head bowed, only the whites of his eyes visible.

“Doctor Gao, has he woken up?”

Though Chen Ge and Doctor Gao stood barely a meter away, the young man showed no awareness of them. His pupils had rolled completely out of sight.

“Probably not.” Doctor Gao signaled for Chen Ge to take a step back. Both of them leaned against the wall to avoid running into Men Nan.

“Then is he sleepwalking?” Even Chen Ge had never seen anything this strange.

“Sleepwalking is a common sleep disorder, but ordinary sleepwalking wouldn’t make his eyes roll back like that.”

They spoke in whispers. After sitting motionless for a while, Men Nan slowly rose without warning.

“Should we wake him?” Their plan had been to intervene at the first sign of abnormal behavior, and this was well beyond abnormal.

“Not yet. Waking him now might further damage his already fragile mind.” Doctor Gao paused. “I’ve been watching his expression. Unless his emotions change sharply, we should let this continue.”

They retreated from the bedroom and observed from outside. Men Nan stood beside the bed for several minutes, then slowly turned toward the living room. Head bowed and eyes still rolled back, he shuffled out.

Chen Ge nudged Doctor Gao lightly. “What is he doing now?”

“I once treated a sleepwalking child with mild OCD. Before bed, he spent half an hour aligning every edge of his mattress. Then, in the middle of the night, he would rise, straighten it again, and return to sleep.” Worry filled Doctor Gao’s face as he watched Men Nan. “Sleepwalkers who return safely to bed are manageable. The danger is when they attempt something unexpected.”

Men Nan left the bedroom without hesitation and went straight to the bathroom. He pushed open the wooden door and walked toward the mirror.

The faucet was turned on, and the bathroom was soon filled with the sound of rushing water.

“Is he planning to wash his hair?”

Chen Ge looked at Doctor Gao, who returned his stare with equal shock. “Don’t look at me. I’ve never seen this either.”

As the water rushed harder, both men hurried to the bathroom. Men Nan stood before the sink, slowly bending forward.

As his head descended, they glimpsed his inverted face. His pupils remained hidden. The instant his hair touched the water, his expression changed; his features twitched as if he had seen something horrifying.

A shiver ran through Chen Ge. He looked behind him, but the room was empty.

“Did he see something in the dream? Are the dream and reality connected?” Men Nan had said the man entered from the living room and stood beside him.

With practiced movements, Men Nan grabbed the shampoo, emptied a generous amount onto his wet hair, and scrubbed mechanically while staring in one fixed direction.

Foam ran down his face. As it reached his eyes and made them instinctively close, terror and panic erupted across his features.

“Quick! Wake him up!”

The moment Doctor Gao shouted this command, Men Nan reached out to strangle himself!

Veins bulged along his arms as he tried to break his own neck. He lost his balance and crashed to the floor, scattering water and foam.

“Wake up, Men Nan!” Doctor Gao and Chen Ge fought to pry his hands loose, but he did not respond. He kept choking himself while trying to smash his head against the sink.

“Detain him!”

Doctor Gao had restrained violent patients before. He ordered Chen Ge to pin Men Nan’s upper body while he removed his belt and bound the young man’s wrists.

“Men Nan, this is Doctor Gao.” After his hands were tied, Doctor Gao held Men Nan’s head with his palm on his forehead to stop the young man from knocking his head into the wall. “It’s alright now; it’s alright now.”

Doctor Gao’s voice was gentle and reassuring, but it had no effect. Men Nan only grew more violent. He snapped at anyone within reach, then bit down on his own tongue until blood seeped between his lips.

“Get me a towel!” Before Doctor Gao finished, Chen Ge had already wedged one between Men Nan’s teeth. He should have awakened by now, yet his eyes kept straining upward. Chen Ge remembered seeing him do the same thing at the park.

He’s looking up! The thing is above his head!Chen Ge clawed at the air over Men Nan’s hair but caught nothing.

“Let’s get him onto the bed.” Doctor Gao had no idea what Men Nan was experiencing. Together, they hauled him off the floor. Even bound and gagged with the towel, he continued trying to injure himself.

Men Nan thrashed his head violently. Afraid he would strike the mirror, Chen Ge stepped forward to steady him—and froze at what the glass revealed.

A man clung to Men Nan’s back. Thin as a branch, he had an asymmetrical face split down the middle, as if two different faces had been sewn together.

The creature strangled Men Nan while trying to force its way into his body, but another presence inside the young man resisted it. Their struggle for control was the source of his agony. Doctor Gao could not see the horror in the mirror. Only Chen Ge could help.

I saw a shadow flee into Room 303’s mirror. This thing must be related to the mirror monster. Breaking the glass should hurt it.Without wasting time on an explanation, Chen Ge drew his mallet and swung.

Glass exploded across the bathroom, the crash shattering the night’s silence. The entire building must have heard it. As the mirror collapsed, Men Nan finally began to wake. He screamed, and his pupils slowly rolled back into view.

At the same time, a shadow glided across the floor as if it was trying to escape.

Chen Ge shoved Men Nan toward Doctor Gao and sprang after the shadow, mallet raised. It had already reached the front door. Snatching up Xiaoxiao—slightly misshapen after serving as his pillow—he hurled her at it.
